body: Context: owner said the CLI must adopt the library's shape. Chosen: clikit module (outfmt, report, textdiff, selection, providerkit) with no format import; dotenv/cli module keeps dotenvcmd, envkit, discover (discover's .env filename rules are dotenv-specific) and the dotenvctl binary; plugins/github and plugins/vercel import only clikit; cmd/textdatactl mounts dotenvcmd by delegating args to dotenvcmd.Execute with WithProgramName('textdatactl dotenv') so exit codes, envelope and exec plugins are identical. providerkit's Source becomes a format-neutral *selection.Selection (Pairs []selection.Pair); envkit keeps its dotenv-typed Selection and converts. Alternatives: moving dotenv.Pair into the base so one Selection type serves both (rejected: grows the locked base for a CLI concern); keeping providerkit in dotenv/cli (rejected: providers would then depend on dotenv).
title: CLI split: clikit shared module, per-format command packages, textdatactl mounts by delegation
